properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is Solana's account-key signature scheme — classical, broken by Shor. The on-chain verification builtin is fixed by the Solana protocol (observable, not replaceable here); the client-side WebCrypto sign/verify IS changeable here but must remain Ed25519-compatible with the chain, so ML-DSA-65 migration is blocked on Solana protocol PQ support. The runtime WebCrypto provider (Node >= 20.18.0 per engines field) decides what this library can ever offer.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 here serves Ethereum-compatible address derivation and pre-signature message hashing in the Secp256k1Program module. Grover gives only a square-root speedup (preimage), so this is not a harvest-now-decrypt-later risk; and the algorithm is pinned by the Solana on-chain secp256k1 program's Ethereum-compatibility semantics — migration is constrained by the chain protocol, not just this repo.
